thread:
maria-sales: Heads-up: Eclipse POC seeing periodic 429s during embeddings bulk load. Started ~14:07 UTC; spikes every ~7m for ~25s. Demo tomorrow morning. Can we triage?

dan-eng: Can you paste a sample 429 body, client headers, batch size and concurrency?

maria-sales: Client 429: {
  "error": "rate_limited", "retry_after": 0.45, "trace_id": "ecl-7f1"
}
Client headers: X-Batch-Size=300, X-Workers=16

sophie-sre: Server log: `429 tenant=eclipse route=/v1/embeddings limit=100 remaining=0 reset=22 token_budget_remaining=60000`
Per-tenant config: per_route_rps=100, token_budget_per_min=240000, burst_window=60s.

kevin-support: Quick tokens calc: if avg 45 tokens/item, 300 items ~13.5k tokens/request. Several concurrent requests will exhaust budget. Also client retries with fixed 250ms backoff -> likely retry amplification.

dan-eng: Immediate mitigations: 1) tell client to reduce batch to <=64 and workers<=8, 2) implement exponential backoff with jitter, 3) send trace_id when 429s occur so we can correlate.

maria-sales: Customer asks for a short-lived bump for the POC ingest window (90m). Can SRE do that?

sophie-sre: I can approve a soft bump: per_route_rps=280 and token_budget_per_min=1.1M for 90m. Will open ticket.

quota-bot: Ticket QTC-7550 created by sophie-sre. Requested: per_route_rps=280, token_budget=1100000/min, duration=90m. Pending on-call approval.

kevin-support: Also flagged POC runbook: "For large embeddings ingest, prefer streaming small batches or use per-item async batching; limit workers; honor Retry-After." Sent guidance to Eclipse.

maria-sales: Eclipse applied client-side changes (workers7, batch=64) while bump is processed. They will keep running and report if 429s persist.

sophie-sre: Soft bump applied (QTC-7550). Monitor dashboard console.redwood.io/tenants/eclipse/limits and logs. If any 429s occur include trace_id.

dan-eng: Monitoring now. If we still see 429s after bump and client changes, we'll need the raw request body with headers.

maria-sales: Update 20m: 429s dropped to zero after client changes + bump. Customer completed ingest. Thanks all.

sophie-sre: Bump expired after 90m and limits reverted. Recommend Eclipse consider Dedicated if they need sustained higher throughput. Closing ticket unless they ask for a permanent increase.
